decisions.reason: The offshore and renewable energy unit is a flagship close to BSM's core competence and fits its strategic direction toward cleaner shipping, so with the market recovering and ample slack at a large firm, results are likely to meet aspirations.
Crew travel management supports the core crewing business, and pandemic-era crew changes made it more relevant, so the shortfall from depressed travel volumes is unlikely to trigger dropping it.
The online vessel information portal is a flagship digital customer interface that deepens client proximity, and digitalisation pressures make keeping and developing it consistent with aspirations.

The mobile performance app is a smaller digital offer whose standalone results are uncertain and could be merged into the portal, but slack and its link to efficiency and emissions goals favour keeping it for now.
